product_descriptions.dior_lip_glow: Moisturizes lips, adds a natural tint and makes them softer. Ideal for everyday use. The color adapts to the natural tone of your lips, and the balm keeps them comfortable all day.
product_descriptions.estee_double_wear: Long-wearing foundation with a matte finish. Evens out skin tone and covers imperfections. Keeps a fresh look all day, even in the heat.
product_descriptions.kerastase_chroma: Mask for color-treated hair. Nourishes and softens the hair and keeps the color rich and shiny. Apply to damp hair after shampooing, leave for 5 minutes, then rinse.
product_descriptions.olaplex_no3: Treatment for damaged hair. Strengthens hair after coloring and styling and leaves it smooth and manageable. Apply to damp hair before shampooing once a week.
product_descriptions.chanel_chance: Eau de parfum with a fruity floral scent: quince and grapefruit, jasmine and rose, white musk. Apply to the wrists and neck.
product_descriptions.estee_night_repair: Repairing serum for all skin types. Hydrates, evens out the skin tone and helps the skin recover overnight. Apply a few drops to clean skin in the evening, before your cream.

reschedule.question: How do I change a booking?
reschedule.answer: Open Profile → My bookings, choose the booking and tap Reschedule. Pick a new time and the booking will be updated.

credits.question: How do credits work?
credits.answer: Credits can pay for a salon booking. The price of a service in credits is shown when you book. Buy credits in Payments and credits; with the Premium plan you get 20 credits every month.

cancel.question: How do I cancel a booking?
cancel.answer: Open Profile → My bookings, choose the booking and tap Cancel. The booking moves to the history. Refund terms depend on the salon’s plan.

return.question: How do I return a product?
return.answer: Message us on Telegram or call us within 7 days of receiving your order. Tell us the product and the reason, and we’ll explain how to return it.

payment.question: How do I pay for a booking?
payment.answer: When booking, choose how to pay: with credits, online or at the salon.
